divergences.reason: A request with no X-GitHub-Api-Version header is served as 2026-03-10. GitHub serves it as 2022-11-28.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-09-28 (recorded in the private research repository).

divergences.reason: X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28 is refused with GitHub's unsupported-version 400. GitHub serves 2022-11-28; it is a later commercial target. Default go-github clients send it and get 400 until they send 2026-03-10.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-09-28 (recorded in the private research repository).

divergences.reason: The version header is applied to unauthenticated requests too. GitHub ignores it when there is no token and serves 2022-11-28.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-09-28 (recorded in the private research repository).

divergences.reason: Returns ["2026-03-10"]; GitHub returns both supported versions.

divergences.reason: The unsupported-version 400 names one supported version: '"2026-03-10" (most recent).' GitHub's lists both.

Tokens in GitHub's documented formats (ghp_, github_pat_, gho_, ghu_, ghr_) are accepted without having been issued, as the default user unless seeded to another; anything else is 401 Bad credentials. There is no per-repository access control for authenticated callers.
JWT claims (iss, exp) are checked; the RS256 signature is not, because the emulator holds no App public key.

The run is created already completed with conclusion success; nothing executes and runs never progress over time. Workflows are the files under .github/workflows on the default branch, and the workflow_dispatch trigger is detected textually.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-09-28 (recorded in the private research repository).

divergences.reason: Deliveries are sent for issues, pull_request, push, check_run and ping only. There is no redelivery route. The User-Agent is GitHub-Hookshot/emulator.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-09-28 (recorded in the private research repository).

divergences.reason: API URLs in responses and Link headers use the origin the client called (the emulator); html_url and other browser links keep https://github.com.
divergences.operator_note: Keeps every link an SDK follows on the emulator.

divergences.reason: Rate-limit headers and GET /rate_limit report GitHub's limits (60 unauthenticated, 5,000 with a token) but nothing is counted or enforced.
Conflicts are detected per file (a file changed differently on both sides conflicts); additions and deletions count whole files, not diff hunks.
The existing search handlers are thin and out of the MVP; search is deferred.
divergences.operator_note: Operator decision, 2026-09-28 (recorded in the private research repository).

divergences.reason: Emulator-only operator routes (reset, state, time, faults, webhooks/flush, health and repository inspection). GitHub has no equivalent.
